text:
zane: FYI saw a couple dev accounts get double-billed when a streaming response got truncated by a toolcall, then the client reconnected and routed to fallback. screenshot of billing shows raw token sum > expected. anyone seen this flow before?
anya: Hmm can you paste the trace id? curious if it's a resume vs fresh session.
zane: trace: r=rt_31 session=ss_8 route=primary -> toolcall -> truncate at 1765439980 reconnect route=secondary session=ss_8-reconn
kim: if the client reuses same session id we should de-dupe. but if route change creates a new ledger shard we might be double-counting because finalization wasn't propagated.
maria: Do we have a clear separation between "stream tokens" and "toolcall tokens" in the ledger? I remember we had an edgecase when toolcalls were emitted mid-stream and we didn't snapshot the prefix.
ops-bot: deploy: billing-ledger v2 rolled at 2026-03-05T03:02Z - added snapshotting, but only for confirmed toolcalls.
zane: here's a minimal log snippet: ```[2026-03-06T10:19:40Z] stream:start id=ss_8 tokens=0
[2026-03-06T10:19:55Z] stream:emit tokens=92
[2026-03-06T10:19:57Z] toolcall:start id=tc_9
[2026-03-06T10:19:59Z] toolcall:truncate reason=client_eof emitted=48
[2026-03-06T10:20:02Z] client:reconnect session=ss_8 route=secondary resume=false
[2026-03-06T10:20:05Z] stream:emit tokens=40
[2026-03-06T10:20:06Z] ledger:charge stream=132 toolcall=48 total=180 ledger_id=L-20260306-31```
anya: Looks like toolcall truncated at 48 but ledger still charged both the 92 prefix + 48 toolcall + resumed 40 = 180. Ideally when truncate+reconnect happens the resumed 40 should be considered continuation of the 92 prefix not additive.
kim: Root cause likely: our resume=false path creates a new provisional offset on the secondary shard and we don't stitch the partial toolcall emission. shard ownership change + no finalization = duplication.
maria: UX problem too: console shows only final per-route charges, not per-session reconciliation. ops teams can't easily tell which part was duplicate. can we show a per-session timeline with token deltas?
zane: proposal: 1) add stream_session_id to all billing traces and console timelines. 2) emit a "truncate_toolcall_overlap" trace when a toolcall truncates mid-stream so reconciliation can subtract overlap on downstream shards. 3) add a boolean in internal API: X-Toolcall-Idempotent for toolchains that guarantee idempotency
anya: +1 on session_id and overlap trace. For the boolean, what semantics? if idempotent=true then duplicate toolcall emissions should be ignored on replays?
kim: semantics: idempotent flag means ledger will only accept one charge per toolcall id globally for a TTL window, not per shard. that would prevent duplicates on reconnections that re-run the same toolcall. tradeoff: needs global dedupe index and TTL eviction.
maria: For console: add a per-session "reconciled tokens" column that shows raw_charged vs reconciled_charged and a small timeline sparkline. Also expose the overlap_reason link to the trace so SRE can click through.
ops-bot: alert: billing.duplicate_charge.count increased x3 in last 1h for dev accounts - alerting group @billing @eng-platform
zane: telemetry add: billing.duplicate_charge.count, billing.truncate_toolcall_overlap.count, billing.ledger_shard_mismatch.count, and trace tag stream_session_id. Also add a debug mode to capture full ledger snapshots for a session (low-sample).
kim: I'll prototype a ledger-side dedupe table + TTL and a console panel for session timelines. estimating 3 days for a PoC. assigning to @kim.
anya: I'll update the internal API spec to include X-Toolcall-Idempotent and streaming resume semantics, plus a backwards-compatible header X-Stream-Session.
maria: I'll mock console UI and consensus wording for what "reconciled" means.
zane: thanks. for immediate mitigation can we set routing policy to prefer sticky-shard routing for active stream sessions to reduce cross-shard reconnections? maybe short-term throttle fallback routing for sessions with active toolcalls.
kim: yes we can add a short sticky window (30s) to keep session pinned. low risk. I'll do that in the router config.
zane: awesome. keeping this thread as the tracker. will post follow-ups with PoC link and logs. :thumbsup:
